# BACTEREMIA ASSOCIATED WITH LISTERIA MONOCYTOGENES

Consult Infectious Diseases in all cases. Identification and treatment of the source of infection, in addition to antimicrobial therapy, is crucial for resolution of infection.
Treatment of listeria infection
Ampicillin 2 gm IV q4h ($$) [R]

# Duration of treatment

Treat for a total duration of at least 2 weeks.
